blocks.prompt: Kaunsi aam shiq NAHI (MCQ 1)? Limitation of liability ki shiq kya karti hai (MCQ 2)?
blocks.explanation: (c) product advertising; (b) kharabi par company ki zimmedari mehdood karti hai.

blocks.prompt: Aam shiqein aur yeh provider aur user dono ko kaise bachati hain, samjhaiye (long question 1).
blocks.explanation: User obligations ghalat istemal mana kar ke provider aur doosre users ko bachati aur users ko tawaqqo batati hain. Limitation of liability provider ko band hone ke ghair maqool daawon se bachati aur users ko un ka khatra batati hai. Privacy and data use users ko batati hai ke un ka data kaise sambhala jata hai. Intellectual property provider ka mawad bachati aur users ko batati hai ke kya copy nahi kar sakte. Termination of service nuqsan deh accounts band karne de kar community ko bachati aur users ko woh qawaid batati hai jin se rasai ja sakti hai. Wazeh shiqein dono ko tanazaat se bachati hain.

items: Paanch shiqein: obligations, liability ki had, privacy, intellectual property, termination.
